newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Feb department store sales down 2.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Feb department store sales down 2.1 pct.

text.p: Sales at department stores in Tokyo fell 2.1 percent in February from a year earlier to 166.3 billion yen, the Japan Department Stores' Association said on Tuesday.
The decline was mainly due to slow takings from bargain sales as well as continued weakness in demand from corporate customers, the association said in its monthly report.
Although sales of men's apparel rose for the first time in four months, sales of women's apparel, sundries and groceries all fell, the statement said.
The report is based on a survey of 30 department stores in Tokyo operated by 14 companies.
